text: A dictionary maps keys to values. Use get(key, default) when a missing key is expected.
A unit test checks a specific behavior. Test empty inputs and boundary values as well as typical inputs.
To fix a bug, reproduce the failure, locate the cause, make a small change, and rerun the relevant tests.
Python indentation defines blocks. Spaces inside string literals are data and must be preserved.
Text can include हिन्दी, 你好, café, and 😀. A tokenizer must preserve these characters exactly.
